title: Yellow Gooey Dutch Oat Stew
description: A comforting and floral Dutch stew featuring molasses and smoked spices, perfect for a sick day. This ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly dish is easy to make and nourishing to eat.
instructions: In a large pot, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the smoked paprika, ground cumin, turmeric powder, sea salt, and black pepper, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the molasses and stir until well combined.
Add the rolled oats and stir until they are evenly coated with the spice mixture.
Gradually add the vegetable broth, whisking continuously to prevent lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir the stew occasionally to prevent the oats from sticking to the bottom of the pot.
After 20 minutes, the stew should be thick and gooey, with a yellow color from the turmeric and molasses.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
